description: This file contains test cases for IRC protocol parsing and sanitization functions, using the Vitest testing framework. It tests functions like parseIrcLine, parseIrcPrefix, sanitizeIrcOutboundText, sanitizeIrcTarget, and splitIrcText, which are imported from the protocol.js module.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for IRC protocol functions.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Asserts that a value matches an expected condition.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases with descriptions and expected behaviors.

methods.name: parseIrcLine
methods.description: Parses an IRC protocol line into its components.

methods.name: parseIrcPrefix
methods.description: Parses the prefix part of an IRC message into nick, user, and host.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcOutboundText
methods.description: Sanitizes outbound IRC text to prevent injection of control characters or commands.

methods.name: sanitizeIrcTarget
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes IRC target strings, rejecting control characters.

methods.name: splitIrcText
methods.description: Splits long IRC message text into chunks based on a specified size.
